title: Malia and Sasha Obama Do Fall Layering Two Very Different Ways
text:

 Both have great outfit formulas. By Kara Nesvig November 9, 2026 EVGA, SXAC Though we're getting closer and closer to the holidays, it's still technically fall—and Malia and Sasha Obama are showing us exactly how to layer for the season.
 Fall can be a bit of a getting-dressed conundrum; for many climates, it's brisk and chilly in the morning but warms up quite a bit throughout the day, leaving you sweating in the sweater and heavy coat that felt so cozy at 8 a.m.
 Both Obama sisters were dressed in two very different, but equally cool versions of fall outfits, giving you all the inspo you need to get through the next few weeks of this layering-heavy season. Malia went preppy in a V-neck polo top and mini skirt paired with flat brown boots and styled her outfit with a classic khaki trench coat over the top, providing a little extra warmth and coverage for those crisp fall mornings and evenings.
 Sasha , on the other hand, wore an all-black outfit, including a turtleneck top and loose-fitting, wide-leg black pants styled with flip-flop sandals and her favorite toe rings , plus a long, dark brown jacket over the top. Accessories-wise, Malia wore a slouchy gray satchel bag over one shoulder, while Sasha opted for glasses and a silver pendant necklace.
 We love seeing how the sisters' styles have evolved over the years, and how each sister has her own unique fashion identity. Sasha tends to prefer flowier, more boho-chic styles like long skirts and babydoll tops , while Malia takes a more minimalist approach to dressing. For the opening of their dad's Presidential Center in Chicago , for example, Sasha wore an off-the-shoulder top and matching skirt cinched with a boho belt, and her sister chose an oversized blazer with a miniskirt. If you're standing in front of your closet wondering what in the world to wear for a fall day, all it takes is some effortlessly cool, easy layering to make your favorite outfits work in ever-changing weather. Let the Obama sisters be your guide!
